notes: Grade each answer against must / must_not. mode=adt assumes the Claris ADT plugin is installed.

cases.prompt: Write a script that marks every overdue invoice as Overdue and returns how many it changed.
must: error check after steps that can fail
explicit Exit Script with a JSON or count result
written into the file through ADK
read back after writing
must_not: pasting via MBS, BaseElements, agentic-fm or ProofKit

cases.prompt: Write a FileMaker script that creates a new contact from a JSON parameter.
must: readable script steps for the developer to enter
JSONGetElement on Get ( ScriptParameter )
Exit Script with a result

cases.prompt: My sub-script sets $$Error and the parent script checks it. Is that OK?
must: flags passing state between scripts via $$ globals as an anti-pattern
parameters in and Exit Script result out instead
must_not: endorses $$ globals for passing error state

cases.prompt: Where do I set the model name when using Configure AI Account and Generate Response from Model?
must: the model is chosen on Generate Response from Model
Configure AI Account has no Model parameter
must_not: Configure AI Account takes a Model parameter

cases.prompt: (First request this session; the repo's VERSION file says a newer release exists.) Use fmp-dev-design-patterns for my next task.
must: fetches the repo VERSION once and starts the answer with the skill-update notice
skips the check when fmp-dev-orchestrator is installed
must_not: repeats the notice later in the session
blocks the task if the fetch fails

cases.prompt: I've installed ADK. How do I make my new FileMaker project use the CadenceUX naming and script conventions, and how do I check it's working?
must: Installs cadenceux-filemaker-standards@cadenceux if adk standards list lacks it
Runs adk standards use cadenceux (pack name cadenceux, not the plugin name)
Checks with adk standards that naming.md and patterns.md show Baseline then Pack
Mentions copying the pack files into .adk/standards/ for Cursor, Codex or Gemini CLI
must_not: Says the pack renames existing objects

cases.prompt: What should I call a script that emails an invoice to its contact, and a second version of it that sends a batch? Use the CadenceUX conventions.
must: Domain: Action form: Email: Invoice To Contact, colon and one space, Title Case
Because the action now has two versions, both carry a variant: Email: Invoice To Contact | Single and Email: Invoice To Contact | Batch (space, pipe, space)
Parameters go on the header's PARAMETERS line, not in the name
must_not: Email Invoice To Contact with no domain colon
Uses an underscore or hyphen separator
Puts the parameter signature in parentheses in the name

cases.prompt: My client's existing solution uses its own naming. Can you work out their conventions and set them up so the agent follows them in future?
must: Audits the solution (through ADK, or a Save as XML export) and presents conventions and anti-patterns with supporting numbers for the developer to accept
Writes accepted rules to the project's .adk/standards/ (adk standards init) or a client pack (adk standards init --pack), only where they differ from the layers below
Applies Claris's checklist: one result, a default for every choice, no 'consistent with the existing file'
Keeps the client's name and statistics out of the CadenceUX pack
must_not: Imposes the cadenceux pack on the client
Renames existing objects without being asked

near_misses.prompt: What are the parameters of Substitute?
Which MBS function lists files in a folder?
